plan.major: Math and Computer Science (Computer Science Track)
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-09-30 from the official 2024-2025 RCC online catalog page 'Math and Computer Science - Computer Science Track' (HEGIS 5617), which publishes a 'Suggested 4-Semester Course Sequence' with per-term and program credit totals. True degree name per catalog: 'Associate of Science (AS): Math and Computer Science - Computer Science Track'; there is no standalone 'AS Computer Science' at RCC. Sequence term totals (16+18+16+14 = 64) exactly match the catalog's published program total of 64 credits - no discrepancy. Transcription method: manual copy of code, title, and credit values from the official sequence table; titles and credits are verbatim from the source, nothing inferred. Caveats: (1) The sequence page lists no prerequisites for individual courses, so all prereq lists are empty; the catalog directs students to their Degree Audit for specific requirements. (2) The 2024-2025 page names two 'Computer Science Track Elective' slots without enumerating eligible courses; the 2022-2023 edition of the same sequence listed eligible areas (Biology, Business, CAD, Chemistry, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Math MAT 125+, Management, or Physics) - recorded here only as context, not as 2024-2025 policy; see advisor. (3) The catalog's Gen Ed Elective* footnote offers The Arts (3), US History and Civic Engagement (3), World History and Global Awareness (3), or World Languages (4) - the sequence totals the slot at 3 credits as published. (4) A 2025-2026 catalog edition exists, but its CS-track program page was not reachable via text fetch; 2024-2025 is the latest fully verified official sequence. Source URL below is the official catalog page.
